# Next.js Video Player with ImageKit

## Stack
- **Runtime**: Node.js 18+
- **Framework**: Next.js 14 (app router)
- **Media**: ImageKit for delivery, HLS streaming, watermarking
- **Subtitles**: SRT, VTT, ASS format support
- **Quality Control**: Adaptive bitrate (240p–1080p)
- **TypeScript**: v5 strict mode

## Project Structure
```
app/                  # Next.js routes
components/           # Player UI components
lib/                  # ImageKit client, media utilities
public/               # Sample videos, assets
.env.local.example    # Template for environment variables
```

## Key Patterns
- **HLS Streaming**: Adaptive bitrate via ImageKit transformations
- **Watermarking**: Dynamic overlay on video; configurable per user/session
- **Subtitles**: Load from SRT/VTT/ASS; auto-detected from file extension
- **Quality Selection**: User can manually select bitrate; default is adaptive
- **Thumbnails**: Auto-generated by ImageKit at key frames
- **JSON Library**: Video metadata stored in JSON (no DB required)

## Common Commands
```bash
npm install                 # Install dependencies
npm run dev                 # Dev server (http://localhost:3000)
npm run build               # Production build
npm run start               # Production server
npm run lint                # ESLint
```

## Environment Setup
```bash
cp .env.local.example .env.local
```

Required `.env.local`:
```
NEXT_PUBLIC_IMAGEKIT_URL_ENDPOINT=https://ik.imagekit.io/YOUR_ID
NEXT_PUBLIC_IMAGEKIT_PUBLIC_KEY=YOUR_PUBLIC_KEY
IMAGEKIT_PRIVATE_KEY=YOUR_PRIVATE_KEY
```

## Important Files
- `lib/imagekit.ts` — ImageKit client & transformation helpers
- `components/VideoPlayer.tsx` — Main player component
- `app/watch/[id]` — Video page with streaming
- `public/videos.json` — Video library metadata

## Notes
- ImageKit free tier included; upgrade for higher storage/bandwidth
- HLS playlist generated dynamically by ImageKit
- Watermark positioning & opacity configurable per transformation
- Test with various subtitle formats locally before deploying
